entities.name: Vakhtang V of Kartli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vakhtang V, also known as Shah Navaz Khan, was a king (mepe) of the Georgian Kingdom of Kartli, a Prince of Mukhrani under the names Vakhtang II and Bakhuta Beg, and a statesman in Safavid Iran. He belonged to the Bagrationi dynasty of Mukhrani, a collateral branch of the royal House of Bagrationi. Vakhtang V was the first king of Kartli from the Mukhrani line, a dynasty that ruled Kartli until 1746. He was also a paternal ancestor of some monarchs of Kakheti and Imereti, as well as of several Russo-Georgian princes, including Pyotr Bagration.
